one_line: A Tibetan monk and an aged Indian abbot meeting amid the ruined Buddhist university of Nalanda after the Khalji raids.

appearance.age_look: Dharmasvamin appears as a lean man in his early 30s; Rahula Śrībhadra appears as a frail, thin man in his late 70s.
appearance.face: Dharmasvamin has an oval face, light brown Tibetan complexion, straight nose, sharp cheekbones, thoughtful warm eyes with a calm half-smile; Rahula has a narrower, wrinkled face, medium brown North Indian complexion, prominent nose, soft tired eyes and a gentle, serene smile.
appearance.hair: Dharmasvamin is fully shaven-headed with a smooth scalp, no facial hair; Rahula’s thinning grey hair is tonsured at the crown and combed back neatly, with a short grey beard and moustache.
appearance.costume: Dharmasvamin wears a maroon wool Tibetan monk’s robe with one shoulder exposed but modestly covered by a saffron cotton upper cloth, layered over a simple dull-ochre under-tunic and dark brown cloth boots; Rahula wears a faded saffron cotton kāṣāya robe over a pale cream under-robe, with a simple dark red cloth belt and plain brown sandals, his robes carefully arranged to cover his body fully and modestly; both have prayer beads at the wrist, Dharmasvamin’s dark wooden, Rahula’s lighter sandalwood.
appearance.signature: Dharmasvamin carries a worn palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord in one hand, while Rahula holds a simple wooden walking staff, its top smoothed by age and use.

ref_desc: Dharmasvamin is a shaven-headed Tibetan monk in maroon and saffron robes with dark wooden beads and a palm-leaf manuscript bundle, beside aged Rahula Śrībhadra in faded saffron and cream robes with sandalwood beads and a wooden staff, using maroon, saffron, cream, dark brown and grey tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of two figures standing side by side amid softly suggested stone ruins: Dharmasvamin, a lean shaven-headed Tibetan monk in his early 30s wearing a maroon wool robe with a saffron upper cloth modestly covering his torso, a dull-ochre under-tunic, and dark brown cloth boots, dark wooden prayer beads at his wrist and a worn palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cord in one hand; and Rahula Śrībhadra, a frail elder with a tonsured crown, thinning grey hair combed back, short grey beard, narrow wrinkled face and serene eyes, dressed in a faded saffron cotton kāṣāya robe over a pale cream under-robe, a dark red cloth belt, plain brown sandals, and light sandalwood beads at his wrist, holding a simple wooden staff smoothed at the top by age, both fully and modestly clothed, using a palette dominated by maroon, saffron, cream, dark brown and grey.
